hook.line: Posting without SEO is like making your video private.
hook.visual: She whips her glasses off and swings them at the lens, her palm fills the frame at 0.75 s; red 'SEO for beginners' label at the top, white 'your fast pass to growth & monetization' box at the bottom.

beats.what: Bold claim spoken while she yanks off her glasses; the red top label and white promise box stay for the whole video.
Her hand swipes across the lens, a pattern interrupt inside the first second.
Intro and promise: 'let me break this down the way nobody explains it'.
Explains the algorithm: each post is tested on a small group of about 200 to 300 people.
Single cut; she defines SEO as the text, speech and keywords that tell the algorithm who the video is for.
Method: write 5 to 10 search phrases, shrink them and drag them off-screen, extend across the whole video.
Gesture-heavy section: repeat the keywords in caption, on-screen text, spoken hook and hashtags.
Analogy: packaging your content to ship it to the right person.
'You're welcome' then CTA: playlist on her page, repost and follow.

characters.acts: Whipped off and swung toward the lens in the hook, then twirled and pointed with during the explanation.
characters.exits: Held in her hand, never put back on.

why_it_works: The opening claim (posting without SEO is like posting privately) hits a fear every small creator has, in the first 3 s.
Physical hook: the glasses come off and her hand swipes the lens inside the first second, a pattern interrupt before any explanation.
A permanent top label and bottom promise box (text on screen the whole time) tell a sound-off viewer exactly what they get.
A concrete, copyable method (5 to 10 search phrases hidden off-screen) makes it worth saving; 11.3k shares.
weaknesses: 142 s with only 1 cut (longest shot 99.8 s) and no zooms (0 punches/min); the visuals never change.
The small sentence captions sit right under the promise box, two text blocks fighting for the bottom band (caption bottom share 0.809).
The method is only described in words; no screen recording shows how to hide the text.
for_robert: Use a physical prop move in the first second (like her glasses whip) as Fred's entrance: he swims in and slaps the lens; but cut or punch in at least every 10 s instead of one 100 s shot.
